<p class="cvGsUA direction-ltr align-justify para-style-body" style="color: #635356; font-family: 'YAFdJjbTu24 1', _fb_, auto; --cyv3zq: 25.333px; --gjplxq: 1.5; line-height: 37px;"><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="font-weight: bold; font-kerning: none;">Payment Information:</span></p><ul><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="color: #635356; font-kerning: none;">A $1000 deposit is required to secure your spot.</span></li><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="color: #635356; font-kerning: none;">The remaining balance must be paid at least 30 days before the camp starts. Payment can be made in two installments.</span></li></ul><p class="cvGsUA direction-ltr align-justify para-style-body" style="color: #635356; font-family: 'YAFdJjbTu24 1', _fb_, auto; --cyv3zq: 25.333px; --gjplxq: 1.5; line-height: 37px;"><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="font-weight: bold; font-kerning: none;">Cancellation &amp; Refund Policy:</span></p><ul><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="color: #635356; font-kerning: none;">Cancellation 90 days before the starting date of the camp: The deposit will be fully refunded.</span></li><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="color: #635356; font-kerning: none;">Cancellation less than 90 days before the starting date of the camp: The deposit will not be refunded. Exception: If cancellation is made for a medical reason, guests must provide medical proof of inability. Your deposit can then be used towards a future camp and must be used within 12 months from the cancellation date.</span></li><li><span class="OYPEnA font-feature-liga-off font-feature-clig-off font-feature-calt-off text-decoration-none text-strikethrough-none" style="color: #635356; font-kerning: none;">For cancellations made by Global Kite Trips, the deposit will be fully refunded. <script id="wpforms-recaptcha-js-after">
var wpformsDispatchEvent = function (el, ev, custom) {
var e = document.createEvent(custom ? "CustomEvent" : "HTMLEvents");
custom ? e.initCustomEvent(ev, true, true, false) : e.initEvent(ev, true, true);
el.dispatchEvent(e);
};
var wpformsRecaptchaCallback = function (el) {
var hdn = el.parentNode.querySelector(".wpforms-recaptcha-hidden");
var err = el.parentNode.querySelector("#g-recaptcha-hidden-error");
hdn.value = "1";
wpformsDispatchEvent(hdn, "change", false);
hdn.classList.remove("wpforms-error");
err && hdn.parentNode.removeChild(err);
};
var wpformsRecaptchaLoad = function () {
Array.prototype.forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll(".g-recaptcha"), function (el) {
try {
var recaptchaID = grecaptcha.render(el, {
callback: function () {
wpformsRecaptchaCallback(el);
}
});
el.setAttribute("data-recaptcha-id", recaptchaID);
} catch (error) {}
});
wpformsDispatchEvent(document, "wpformsRecaptchaLoaded", true);
};
//# sourceURL=wpforms-recaptcha-js-after
